Your scoped token stays 100% local on your machine, and clicking Export & Auto-Push (.zip) automatically rolls prior DNA hashes into previous_hashes, updates your live manifest.json or merges into catalog.json, stamps the live URL into your release .zip, and triggers update pings for all {Citizens}.

edge_guide_host_catalog_desc: Instead of maintaining individual manifest.json URLs for 20+ {mods}, point all of your {mods} to a single https://.../catalog.json endpoint containing an 'artifacts' array. Sanctuary OS automatically resolves each installed {mod} inside catalog.json by artifact_id, name, current_hashes, or previous_hashes.

edge_guide_host_cf_desc: Link your GitHub repository to Cloudflare Pages (or upload manifest.json to your sovereign web server). Every git push automatically deploys your updated manifest.json to the global edge with zero bandwidth cost.

edge_guide_host_github_desc: 1. Create a free public GitHub repository (e.g., my-sanctuary-manifests). 2. Upload your exported manifest.json (or a single catalog.json for all your {mods}). 3. Open the file on GitHub and click 'Raw' to copy the raw.githubusercontent.com URL. 4. Paste that URL into Decentralized Static Uplink URL before exporting your release .zip.
edge_guide_lineage_how_desc: Sanctuary OS identifies {mods} by cryptographic SHA-256 DNA rather than fragile filenames. Every exported manifest.json tracks three DNA layers so updates and multi-module suites never desync:
edge_guide_lineage_how_title: How DNA Lineage Tracking Operates Under the Hood
edge_guide_lineage_layer1_desc: Records the primary .package hash plus every sibling .package and .ts4script module in the active release. All sibling modules in a multi-file suite (like MCCC) are verified as current and grouped under a single parent folder card.
edge_guide_lineage_layer2_desc: Every time you click Export Static Release (.zip) over an existing Sandbox folder (or append historical hashes in Details & Versions), prior release hashes roll into previous_hashes. When Sanctuary OS polls your remote manifest.json, any {Citizen} whose installed file matches a hash in previous_hashes immediately receives an Update Available alert.
edge_guide_lineage_layer3_desc: When a {Citizen} drops your new v1.1.0 .zip into Sanctuary OS, the ingestion engine cross-checks their installed {Vault} against previous_hashes. Even if you renamed MyMod_v1.0.package to MyMod_v1.1.package, Sanctuary OS locates the old v1.0 file by its lineage DNA and replaces it in-place inside the exact same subfolder—preventing duplicate {mod} collisions.
edge_guide_lineage_rules_desc: In Rules & Upload, dependencies and conflicts can reference other {mods} by SHA-256 hash, Registry UUID, or plain {mod} name (e.g., 'XML Injector'). Sanctuary OS resolves both structured rule objects and plain string names automatically.
edge_guide_lineage_rules_title: Flexible Dependency & Conflict Resolution (DNA Hash or Designation)
edge_guide_step1_desc: Drop your .package, .ts4script, and optional .cfg/.ini payloads into Dev/Sandbox (or click Import in the {Mason} Workshop). Open the {mod} dossier and configure its Details & Versions (Designation, {Mason} Version, Compliance Tier 0–4, Engine Versions), Files & Folders (Twin scripts, Add-on modules, Folder Topology), and Rules & Upload (Required DLC, Dependencies, and Severity 3–4 Collisions).
edge_guide_step1_title: Stage Your {Mod} in the Dev Sandbox
edge_guide_step2_desc: Paste the raw endpoint where your manifest.json (single {mod}) or catalog.json (all your {mods} in one file) will reside—such as GitHub Raw, Cloudflare Pages, GitLab Raw, or your sovereign domain. Sanctuary OS embeds this uplink URL directly into both manifest.json and override.json inside your release .zip.
edge_guide_step3_desc: Click Export Static Release (.zip) in Rules & Upload (or the top-right inbox icon). Sanctuary OS computes the SHA-256 DNA of every file in your release, writes manifest.json and override.json into your Sandbox directory, and compiles {ModName}_v{Version}_SanctuaryRelease.zip. Upload the .zip to your distribution hub (Patreon, Itch.io, CurseForge, SFS) and push manifest.json to your static endpoint.
edge_guide_step4_desc: When deploying v1.1.0+, place the updated .package/.ts4script payloads into the same Sandbox directory, increment the {Mason} Version field, and click Export Static Release (.zip) again. Sanctuary OS automatically inspects your prior manifest.json and SQLite ledger, rolls the old v1.0.0 SHA-256 hashes into previous_hashes (archive_hashes), and binds the new hashes as current_hashes. Update manifest.json on your static host—every {Citizen} running v1.0.0 will immediately receive an Update Available telemetry ping!
edge_guide_step5_desc: A {Citizen} drops your release .zip into Sanctuary OS once. With zero confirmation prompts, Sanctuary OS binds your manifest_url and DNA lineage in SQLite, marks the {mod} STABLE, coalesces multi-file suites into a single parent card, enforces your DLC/Dependency/Conflict rules, pings them when you update manifest.json, and overwrites outdated files in-place (even if renamed) when they drop the new .zip.

schema_doc_parsers_desc: Maps file extensions to native Rust binary parsers (dbpf, ts4script, rage_rpf) and UI badge designations (PACKAGE, SCRIPT, CONFIG).

schema_doc_lo_templates_desc: Formatting patterns applied when Strategy is set to Numeric Prefix ({index:03}_) or Manifest List (*{filename}).
schema_doc_manifest_header_desc: Complete Resource.cfg or manifest header synthesized when compiling Folder Priority override tiers.
schema_doc_tiers_desc: Defines the load sequence tiers available to {Citizens}. Higher Priority Weight tiers override lower tiers.
schema_doc_lab_ram_desc: Seconds the engine must run steadily before {Lab} verifies ignition stability, plus Min RAM Delta (%) and Warm Cache RAM Delta (%) thresholds.
schema_doc_lab_saves_desc: Save file extensions monitored during {Lab} verification runs.
schema_doc_exc_meta_desc: Unique signature ID, target log hint, and Threat Level (Critical, Warning, or Info) surfaced when a fault log matches.
schema_doc_tc_world_desc: User data sectors and config files (relative to user_data_dir) archived during World State {Backups} snapshots.
schema_doc_tc_engine_desc: Core engine binary sectors (relative to the installation root) archived during Engine Core {Backups} snapshots.

landing_partners_about_drawer_sub: 100% Data Sovereignty • Turnkey Setup • Bilateral Uplink • Governance
landing_partners_what_h1: 1. Sovereign Game Spoke — Never a Central Silo
landing_partners_what_p1: A Sanctuary OS Partner Spoke is an independent, community-governed game workspace (e.g. Skyrim, GTA V, Stardew Valley, Baldur's Gate 3). Unlike legacy modding portals, your community owns its own Supabase PostgreSQL database, Master Schema, {Mod} registry, and Chameleon themes. Either side can sever the uplink ('Cut the Cord') at any time with zero data loss.
landing_partners_what_h2: 2. Zero Platform Tax (0% Cut) & Mutual Supporter Perks
landing_partners_what_p2: Sanctuary Foundry takes 0% of {Mason} or Partner Spoke revenue. Partner Spokes link their own non-custodial Stripe, Ko-fi, or Patreon checkout directly in Wayfinder Operations, and every $5 a {Citizen} contributes to a verified Partner Spoke automatically grants them +30 days of Global Daily Dev Build clearance across Sanctuary OS.
landing_partners_setup_h1: 1. Provision Your Supabase Instance & Run schema.sql
landing_partners_setup_p1: Create a dedicated Supabase project owned by your community Wayfinders. Open the SQL Editor and execute Sanctuary OS's 36-table schema.sql bootstrap script to initialize profiles, {mods}, {mod}_versions, {masons}, {blueprints}, audit_logs, and row-level security (RLS) policies.
landing_partners_setup_p2: Define your game's supported {Mod} file extensions (.package, .ts4script, .pak, .esp, .rpf, .asi), installation target folders, load-order rules, and conflict radar heuristics inside your Master Schema JSON.
landing_partners_connect_p1: Once your Partner Spoke dossier is approved by Keepers Core, open Wayfinder Operations -> Spoke Control -> Spoke Setup & Maintenance to generate your SANCTUARY-UPLINK:// bundle containing your Project URL, Anon Key, and Service Role Key.
landing_partners_connect_p2: Keepers Core runs a live schema and RLS handshake check against your Spoke. Once verified, your workspace goes live on the Sanctuary OS Hub switcher for Desktop, Web, and Mobile PWA {Citizens}.
landing_partners_maintain_p1: Govern your Spoke day-to-day from Wayfinder Operations: appoint Architects and Oversight moderators, verify {Masons}, triage community dispatches, review heuristic malware flags, and rotate your Supabase keys anytime with zero downtime.
landing_partners_maintain_p2: Every administrative action is recorded in your Spoke's immutable audit_logs table. If your community ever wishes to operate standalone, click 'Cut the Cord' in Spoke Control to sever the Hub uplink immediately while keeping 100% of your database.
